race.comment: Tricky race to kick off the card with a few of these facing the starter for the first time. Of the raced brigade, connections had such a high opinion of WIN STAR (12) that they competed her in Listed and Group company when last in work and will appreciate the sharp drop back in grade here. Revved up for this with a recent trial placing and can run a big race while fresh. METRIC (13) hit the frame over this sprint journey when resuming and will have come on with that run now under the belt. Shapes as a leading prospect. PINOT PIRATE (5) is on debut but has shown ability at the trials and is sure to be well-educated out of the Munce barn. Include in calculations. FLARESSENCE (8) saluted in a recent trial and only needs some luck navigating from the sticky alley to be playing a role in the outcome. NOVELTY (4) next best with Maloney on board.
